title: Cold Heading Setter / Operator trainee
description:
Trainee Machine Setter / Operator

Location: Redditch

Hours: Monday–Thursday 8:00am–4:30pm, Friday 8:00am–3:00pm

Job Type: Full-time, Traineeship with permanent opportunity

Salary: To be discussed

Real Personnel are currently recruiting for a Trainee Machine Setter / Operator to join a well-established manufacturing company based in Redditch.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with an engineering qualification and a hands-on, mechanical background who is looking to develop their skills in a specialist manufacturing environment.

No previous cold heading experience is required, as full training will be provided over a 12–18 month period.

Duties Include:
  • Learning to set and operate specialist manufacturing machinery.
  • Assisting with machine tooling, adjustments and maintenance.
  • Carrying out quality inspections on finished products.
  • Identifying and resolving basic mechanical issues.
  • Working alongside experienced setters to develop technical skills.
  • Gradually taking responsibility for multiple machines.
Requirements:
  • Level 2 or 3 Engineering qualification (apprenticeship preferred).
  • Good mechanical knowledge and practical hands-on skills.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Basic computer literacy.
  • Willingness to learn and develop new skills.
  • Reliable, motivated and able to work independently or within a team.
What's on Offer:
  • Full training from experienced engineers.
  • Opportunity to develop specialist setting and toolmaking skills.
  • Monday–Friday daytime hours with an early Friday finish.
  • Long-term career development within an established manufacturer.
  • Opportunity for permanent employment following successful completion of training.
